title: Signing a Home-Site Lease Repayment Agreement — Resident Signature Reference
content:
A repayment agreement on the Home-Site Lease spreads the covered balance that is left after the down payment over installments, and the resident signs it on the day the down payment is made.

## When the installments are fixed

- The installments of a repayment agreement are fixed only after the notices on the lease carry the nonpayment notice whose amount demanded the agreement covers.
- Before the installments of a repayment agreement are fixed, the rent ledger must carry the down payment received on the signing date.

| Notices on the lease | Rent ledger | Installments |
|---|---|---|
| carry the nonpayment notice whose amount demanded the agreement covers | carries the down payment received on the signing date | may be fixed |
| carry no such nonpayment notice | — | not yet fixed |
| — | carries no down payment received on the signing date | not yet fixed |

## Effect on a nonpayment notice

Paying the full amount demanded by the cure deadline cures a nonpayment notice, and so does a repayment agreement signed before that deadline that covers the whole amount demanded; the lease then stays active while the installments are paid on time.

*Hypothetical.* A notice demanding 1,482.50 carries a cure deadline of 16 May. An agreement covering the whole 1,482.50, signed on 12 May, cures the notice; the lease stays active while the installments are paid on time.

## The resident's tool: `sign_repayment_agreement_730960e3`

**Capability.** The resident signs a repayment agreement on their own Home-Site Lease, dated today, undertaking to repay the past-due balance it covers in the stated number of installments of the stated amount, the first falling due on the first due date. No payment is taken and the lease balance is not changed. Afterwards the agreement, its covered balance, installment count, installment amount and first due date show among the notices on the lease.

**Invocation.** This is the resident's own tool: the agent unlocks `sign_repayment_agreement_730960e3` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `lease_id` | the lease reference number of the resident's own home-site lease, as the resident desk read it out from the lease lookup | identifier |
| `amount_covered` | the past-due balance the agreement covers, before the down payment | USD, two decimal places (cents) |
| `installment_count` | the number of installments | whole number |
| `installment_amount` | the amount of each installment | USD, two decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |
| `first_due_date` | due date of the first installment | YYYY-MM-DD |

**Return.** On success a receipt with `status` "signed", `agreement_id` (reference number of the agreement), `lease_id`, `amount_covered` (USD, two decimal places), `installment_count` (whole number), `installment_amount` (USD, two decimal places) and `first_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). The tool defines no error responses.
